title: 2010 AMC 10A Problem 8
statement: Tony works \(2\) hours a day and is paid \(\$0.50\) per hour for each full year of his age. During a six month period Tony worked \(50\) days and earned \(\$630.\) How old was Tony at the end of the six month period?

solutions.text:
Tony worked \(2\cdot50=100\) hours, so his average hourly pay was \(\$630\div100=\$6.30.\) Because his hourly pay is \(\$0.50\) times his age in full years, his average age on the days he worked was \(6.30\div0.50=12.6\) years. During a six-month period his age can change by at most one, so he must have worked some days at age \(12\) and some at age \(13.\) Thus he was \(13\) at the end of the period.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Compute the total hours worked and average hourly pay
Divide the average hourly pay by \(\$0.50\) to get the average age
